parameters.name: AlarmUniqueInfo
parameters.description:
The unique ID of the alert event.

> To query the exception information of a single alert event, provide the unique ID of the alert event. You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: AssetsTypeList
parameters.description: The collection of asset types.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster for which you want to query alert events.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The container search field. Valid values:

- **instanceId**: instance ID
- **appName**: application name
- **clusterId**: cluster ID
- **regionId**: region
- **nodeName**: node name
- **namespace**: namespace
- **clusterName**: cluster name
- **image**: image name
- **imageRepoName**: image repository name
- **imageRepoNamespace**: image repository namespace
- **imageRepoTag**: image tag
- **imageDigest**: image digest

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the container search field.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description: Specifies whether the alert events to query have been handled. Valid values:

parameters.name: DetectSource
parameters.description: The detection source. This parameter is invalid.

parameters.name: EventNames
parameters.description: The subtypes of the alert events. Separate multiple subtypes with commas (,).

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The data source identifier of the alert event. The value is fixed as sas.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID of the asset affected by the alert event.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The unique ID that identifies the alert event record.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: Levels
parameters.description: The severity levels of the alert events to query. Separate multiple severity levels with commas (,). The severity levels are listed in descending order. Valid values:

parameters.name: MultiAccountActionType
parameters.description:
The multi-account query type. Default value: **0**. Valid values:
- **0**: Queries data of the current account.
- **1**: Queries data of all accounts.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the asset affected by the alert event.

parameters.name: OperateErrorCodeList
parameters.description: The collection of alert event handling result codes.

parameters.name: OperateTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the handling time.

parameters.name: OperateTimeStart
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the handling time.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of alert events to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: **20**. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ParentEventTypes
parameters.description: The Alarm Metric of the alerting events to query. Valid values:

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The alert name or asset information to query.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member account in the resource directory.
>Call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: SortColumn
parameters.description:
The custom sort field. Default value: **operateTime**. Valid values:

- **lastTime**: the most recent occurrence time.
- **operateTime**: the processing time.

> This field takes effect only when **Dealed** is set to Y.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The custom sort type. Default value: **desc**. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

> This parameter takes effect only when **Dealed** is set to Y.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The alert source.

parameters.name: SourceAliUids
parameters.description: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs that generated the alerts.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the alert events to query. Valid values:

parameters.name: StrictMode
parameters.description: Specifies whether the alert is identified in strict mode.

parameters.name: SupportOperateCodeList
parameters.description: The list of operation types supported by the alert.

parameters.name: TacticId
parameters.description: The tactic ID of ATT&CK.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The target type for container retrieval. Valid values:
- **containerId**: container ID.
- **uuid**: server UUID.
- **imageUuid**: image UUID.

parameters.name: TimeEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the latest occurrence time range.

parameters.name: TimeStart
parameters.description: The start time of the latest occurrence time range.

parameters.name: UniqueInfo
parameters.description: The unique key of the security alert.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUIDs of the servers for which you want to query alerts. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
